parts.passageHtml:
{[A.][298250]} {[Coffee is grown in more than 50 countries around the equator and provides a living for more than 20 million farmers.][298261]} {[Altogether, up to 100 million people worldwide are involved in the growing, processing, trading and retailing of the product.][298280]}

{[B.][298301]} {[Coffee is the second most valuable commodity after crude oil.][298312]} {[It is the most valuable agricultural commodity in world trade - in 2000, exports worldwide totalled $8.][298323]} {[7bn.][298334]} {[But the journey from farms to the supermarket shelf is a long and tortuous one with many people taking their cut along the way.][298336]}

{[C. From tree to supermarket shelf it has been estimated the coffee beans can change hands as many as 150 times.][298361]} {[The final price of a cup of coffee in the West will have absorbed the costs of insurance, taxes, transportation, processing, packaging, marketing, storage and much more.][298382]} {[Of the £1.][298408]} {[75 charged for a cappuccino in a London coffee shop, the grower will be lucky to receive 5p.][298420]}

{[D. Between 1994 and the end of 2001 the price of robusta beans (used chiefly in instant coffee) plummeted from around 180 cents to just 17 cents per pound, a 30-year low.][298441]} {[Similarly, the value of high-quality arabica beans has suffered.][298474]} {[While it is estimated that the world coffee trade generates $60bn in revenues, producing countries retain just over 10 per cent of this.][298485]}

{[E. When world prices fall, growers suffer an immediate reduction in income; but there is no noticeable reduction in supermarket prices of coffee.][298509]} {[In contrast, when the market price of coffee gains, as it did by 50 per cent in 1994, for example, retail prices rise promptly.][298531]}

{[F. For many farmers, the collapse in prices means that they have failed to recover their production costs for several years running.][298556]} {[This has had a devastating impact.][298578]} {[Some have abandoned their land and gone in search of work in cities.][298584]} {[However, an equally uncertain and poverty-stricken life awaits in urban towns, but without the support of community and land.][298598]} {[For those who opt to stay at home, the lack of labour for crop maintenance reduces the quality and value of the coffee, further depressing returns.][298617]}

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 1 - 7:

Are the following statements TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN according to the information in the passage?

TRUE  the statement matches the information in the passage.

FALSE the statement contradicts the information in the passage.

NOT GIVEN  the information is not found in the passage.

questions.text: The Menzas have tried growing coca leaf instead of coffee
questions.explanationHtml: (In other parts of the same area, somehave turned to growing drugs in order to survive; higher prices are paid for coca leaf (the raw material for cocaine). The Menzas have stayed loyal to the coffee crop but not without great personal sacrifices) .  scan ý về “growing coca” => The Menza vẫn trung thành với coffee “stay loyal to the coffee crop” , “some” ở đây chỉ những người dân khác

questions.text: In trade, only crude oil is more important than coffee.
questions.explanationHtml:
Coffee is the second most valuable commodity after crude oil.

“coffee” là “second most valuable” => “oil” là “most valuable” giá trị nhất

=> oil > coffee

questions.text: The Menzas receive 50% of the supermarket price for their coffee.
questions.explanationHtml: Thông tin không có trong bài NG

questions.text: An increase in transportation costs has had a serious effect on the price of coffee.
questions.explanationHtml: The final price of a cup of coffee in the West will have absorbed the costs of insurance, taxes, transportation, processing, packaging, marketing. bài chỉ đề cập “transportation” là một yếu tố tạo nên “price” của 1 “cup of coffee”, không hề đề cập “the increase in transportation costs”

questions.text: In the late 1990s both world and supermarket prices dropped.
questions.explanationHtml:
When world prices fall, growers suffer an immediate reduction in income; yet there is no noticeable reduction in supermarket prices of coffee. In contrast, when the market price of coffee gains, as it did by 50 per cent in 1994, for example, retail prices rise promptly.

scan ý tìm “late 1990s”  “in 1994”

tuy giá cà phê thế giới giảm “world price falls”, giá siêu thị lại không có  giảm “no noticeable reduction” =>  contradict ý trong đề => false

questions.text: Setting up a co-operative is always an effective solution for these farmers.
questions.explanationHtml: Many growers have joined with their neighbours to set up co-operative marketing ventures, which enable them to by-pass the middlemen. All too often, however, even the co-op cannot get finance to buy the crop, and members still sell to local traders (commonly called coyotes in Latin America) for cash, rather than wait for a better price. scan ý về “co-operative” => paraphrase “always” thành “all too often”, nhưng màcở đây là thường xuyên thất bại “cannot get the finance” trong việc “buy the crop” => không hề là một “effective solution” => ngược ý đề

questions.text: The farmers have less and less money to spend on their families.
questions.explanationHtml: Producers have reported to the Fairtrade Foundation reduced spending on housing, children's education (especially where structural adjustment has led to higher school fees), health and food. paraphrase “reduced spending on” thành” less and less money”

options.text: to advise readers against buying non-Fairtrade coffee
to explain how coffee farmers are exploited by international markets
to advise coffee farmers like the Menzas how to make a good living
to encourage readers to protest about the current situation

questions.explanationHtml:
14

Producers have reported to the Fairtrade Foundation reduced spending on housing, children's education (especially where structural adjustment has led to higher school fees), health and food. 

“producers” ở đây là các nông dân cà phê “report” với Fairtrade  đưa ra các bằng chứng họ phải giảm chi tiêu gia đình, vì họ đang bị “exploited” bóc lột
